reviews.text: Excellent! The staff is super attentive and well-prepared. I highly recommend both the daycare and the hotel!

Our routine changed, and our bulldog could no longer be left alone for so long. That's when I started researching and visiting some pet schools, always very carefully and selectively, because choosing a place like that is, ultimately, choosing who will take care of a piece of our heart. I was already quite discouraged after looking for several schools near my home or work. Until, thanks to a friend and neighbor, I discovered Buddies. And today I can say, without exaggeration, that it's an extension of my home. Even before Sheldon fell in love with the professionals, the games, the furry friends, and all the affection he receives every day, I felt safe—and that's priceless. The space is wonderful, welcoming, and thoughtfully designed, something that has always been essential to me. I already had a great reference, but living this experience exceeded all expectations. Because he's a bulldog, the care is even more special: the staff is always attentive to ensure he doesn't overdo the play and to guarantee his comfort, especially on warmer days. I took my first trip without him at the end of 2025, and leaving him at the hotel was a decision made with a clear heart, knowing that he was being cared for with love, attention, and respect. Sheldon started attending school once a week, then moved to twice, and next month he'll be going three times! 💙 He spends his afternoons completely occupied: playing, sniffing, treasure hunts, rest time, music therapy, relaxation… it's incredible to see so much creativity and care to keep him stimulated and happy.

The professionals are kind, gentle, and delicate — you can clearly see that they love what they do. The result is evident at home: a healthy, balanced, and happy puppy. And on the days he doesn't go to school… then it's total clinginess to mom!

I am immensely grateful to have found a place where my dog ​​is treated like family.
My dog ​​loves Buddies!!! It's her second home! The caregivers are super polite and caring!

My Golden Retriever, Chiara, is loving the days she spends there! She gets out of the car so happy, she has so much fun!!! She's also stayed at the hotel because I had to travel! Everything is perfect.
The staff are wonderful, super careful and affectionate!!
I definitely recommend it!!!!

Great service!
My dog ​​is always very well taken care of, whether at the daycare or the hotel. The staff is very attentive to the pets.
Great place and excellent staff. My dog ​​loves going there. I highly recommend it!

My beagles would definitely recommend Buddies in Itaim, they love it. We can follow their daily routine through the cameras and the space is super suitable. Thank you to the team for the care and affection they show my girls.

They are perfect! They looked after Formiga (my dog) and sent updates and photos of how he was doing every day. We still have access to the cameras, and the place is great. The monitors are very attentive. I loved it! I will always come back ❤️
The staff provided wonderful service, they were super attentive, Trufa LOVES going there!
I leave my dogs at the dog hotel and they love it! They get super excited to go in. And the staff are very affectionate with them.

The way the Buddies team takes care of my dog ​​is amazing. Roma came to me traumatized after spending her first two months of life being mistreated by a drug-addicted couple, and her socialization at the beginning was super complicated. She was scared, afraid to interact, and terrified of humans.
Buddies, with all the care, love, patience, and affection they have for her, added to the love she receives at home, has helped and continues to help a lot. She's already a completely different dog.
Maybe you don't realize the difference you make in the lives of the families of the dogs you care for, but in my family, the impact of your work has been extremely positive. Thank you so much!

Wonderful! I've been a fan ever since my dog ​​went to the Moema location, and I couldn't be happier, and he feels better cared for, now that they've opened here in Itaim. The facilities are impeccable and comfortable for them. Everyone treats the dogs with the utmost care, and it's also an excellent boarding option. We love everything, absolutely everything, and I wouldn't trade Buddies for anything. There's nothing better :)

I feel very comfortable leaving my dogs at Buddies Daycare & Hotel - Itaim. I have two rescued mixed-breed dogs who are quite timid, and the team handled the entire adaptation process with great patience and care. Thank you so much to all the professionals for the attention given to Filipe and Melissa!

Buddies is a safe and social place for our little ones. My little one is quite difficult, and I leave her there knowing she's being well cared for and in an environment with good people. I trust them completely! There are also cameras so we …

My dog ​​LOVES Buddies! He gets so happy when he goes to daycare. The facilities are great, the staff are attentive, and you can keep track of your pet's daily activities with the cameras they have installed! 10/10
I HIGHLY recommend them! Super trustworthy, amazing team!!!!
